task: SCRUM-306 (Define role permission matrix for the seven roles)
sources: AI-Augmented Engineering Intelligence Platform Architectural Blueprint & Defensible Technical Specification v3.0 §6.2, §6.5, §7.5, §10.3, §11.1, §11.2

scope_rules.tenant_isolation: Strict multi-tenant boundary enforced at PostgreSQL database layer via Row-Level Security (RLS) on app.current_tenant_id (Architecture §6.3, SRS §2.4.1).
scope_rules.project_scoping: Within an authorized tenant, access to project data is further restricted to explicitly assigned projects by ABAC policy (SRS §2.4.1, §3.2.1.3).
scope_rules.contributor_data_scoping: Developers may view only their own personal code quality and review telemetry; cross-contributor telemetry is restricted (SRS §2.3, §2.4.1).

roles.description: Software engineer responsible for feature implementation, code quality tracking, AST/SCIP call-tree exploration, and triggering refactor analysis.
Agile facilitator responsible for sprint velocity, team burndown charts, WIP limit monitoring, and operational roadblock mitigation including reviewer reassignment.
Project manager responsible for sprint planning, delivery milestone tracking, and primary evaluation and resolution of Jira Acceptance Criteria scope creep alerts.
System architecture authority responsible for technical debt analysis, SCIP call graph lookups, mandatory review gate for sanitized ADRs, and sign-off for global pattern publishing.
Delivery executive responsible for portfolio-wide delivery health oversight, bottleneck intervention, and mobile one-tap reviewer reassignment.
Executive leadership with read-only strategic oversight of portfolio delivery health, deadline risks, and high-level DORA benchmarks.
Organization administrator with full administrative authority over tenant settings, user roles, webhook integration credentials, and GDPR Article 17 erasure requests.

actions.description: Retrieve verified DORA metrics (Lead Time for Changes, Deployment Frequency, Change Failure Rate, Mean Time to Recovery) for an assigned project.
preconditions: Authenticated tenant context verified via JWT
User assigned to target project (ABAC)

actions.description: View aggregate portfolio-wide delivery health, cross-project deadline risks, and consolidated DORA benchmarks.
preconditions: Authenticated tenant context verified via JWT

actions.description: Monitor team velocity, sprint burndown charts, and Work In Progress (WIP) limit congestion.
preconditions: Authenticated tenant context verified via JWT
User assigned to target project (ABAC)

actions.description: Receive and act upon automated two-stage Acceptance Criteria scope creep alerts (POSSIBLE_SCOPE_CHANGE) via Slack and mobile push notifications.
preconditions: Jira webhook AC modification detected and verified
Targeted LLM verifier emits structured scope alert JSON

actions.description: Execute privileged one-tap reviewer nudge or reassignment via mobile client companion or web dashboard.
preconditions: Server-side biometric token or session authorization verified
PR pending review exceeds 48-hour threshold

actions.description: Track personal contributor code quality metrics, review turnaround statistics, and assigned pull request statuses.
preconditions: Authenticated user identity matches requested contributor scope (ABAC own-data)

actions.description: Explore interactive React Flow call graph visualizers, SCIP symbol hierarchies, and technical debt hotspots.
preconditions: Authenticated tenant context verified via JWT
Repository SCIP index precomputed and cached in RAM

actions.description: Trigger AI-assisted refactoring analysis and candidate PR generation with 4-tier deterministic sandbox verification.
preconditions: ASSERT repository_head_sha == scip_index_metadata_sha
Execution contained within gVisor/Firecracker sandbox (--network none)

actions.description: Execute semantic vector search over approved architectural decision records within the tenant partition or globally visible patterns.
preconditions: PostgreSQL RLS filter: tenant_id == current_setting('app.current_tenant_id') OR visibility == 'GLOBAL'

actions.description: Sign off on sanitized Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to allow embedding and indexing in the tenant-private vector partition.
preconditions: Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop review of Presidio PII scrub report and LLM abstraction diff
Transition record status from pending_review to approved

actions.description: Promote an approved ADR from tenant-private to GLOBAL visibility across all enterprise tenants on the platform.
preconditions: Strict RBAC Gate: User role is SOLUTION_ARCHITECT or TENANT_ADMIN (HTTP 403 otherwise)
Mandatory Precondition: ASSERT adr.status == 'approved' AND adr.sanitization_verified == true (HTTP 422 otherwise)

actions.description: Configure, update, or revoke OAuth tokens, HMAC signing secrets, and webhook endpoints for GitHub, Jira, and Slack integrations.
preconditions: Authenticated TENANT_ADMIN role
Secrets encrypted via integration credential vault prior to PostgreSQL persistence

actions.description: Provision tenant user accounts, assign RBAC roles, and execute GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure cryptographic salt destruction.
preconditions: Authenticated TENANT_ADMIN role
GDPR erasure permanently purges user salt in KMS and overwrites PII with [DELETED]
